_comment: The optional modules the installers offer, one entry per non-hidden descriptor in src/Pickle.Modules (ModulePackagingTests keeps this file and the code in step). packaging/modules.py turns it into the MSI feature tree and the RPM sub-packages. rpmRecommends: Fedora packages that provide the tools a module drives (weak dependencies: installed when available, never required).

modules.name: nmap
modules.description: Scan builder and results browser: panel and pk nmap (needs nmap installed)

modules.name: Docker / Podman
modules.description: Containers, images, volumes and compose projects: panel and pk docker

modules.name: Kubernetes
modules.description: Contexts, namespaces, pods, deployments and services: panel and pk k8s

modules.name: GitHub
modules.description: Pull requests, issues and workflow runs: panel and pk gh (uses the gh CLI)

modules.name: Language versions
modules.description: Prompt segments for python, java, ruby, php, deno, bun, terraform, elixir, lua, swift, zig and dart

modules.name: Long-command notifier
modules.description: A desktop notification when a command that took a while finishes (toast, notify-send, osascript)

modules.name: Command explainer
modules.description: pk explain and Alt+Shift+E: what each part of a command line does, offline, with warnings for dangerous ones

modules.name: Secrets vault
modules.description: API keys and tokens in Credential Manager / the Secret Service / Keychain, or an encrypted file: pk secret set, get, run

modules.name: WSL & Linux containers
modules.description: WSL distributions (Windows) and Distrobox, Toolbx, LXC and Incus containers (Linux): list, start, stop, enter, export, remove

modules.name: Theme packs
modules.description: Twelve extra themes: Monokai, One Dark, Kanagawa, GitHub, Oxocarbon, Night Owl, …
